what: Held-out sources (eval_heldout2), context rows, per-row mean field match under original and harmonised gold

bootstrap.type: paired cluster bootstrap over groups, percentile, ratio of sums
bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, n_clusters, size=(B, n_clusters)) over sorted unique groups
bootstrap.interval: np.quantile 0.025 and 0.975 of sum(values in drawn clusters)/count(rows in drawn clusters)

group_rank_note: 0-based index of the row's cluster in evaluate3.cluster_ci's sorted order of the original group ids; draw clusters in this order
precision_note: context values are full float64 (unrounded); rounding changes the 5th decimal of the intervals
